parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 reduced val_bpb from 1.0449 to 1.0116. Capacity increase seems very effective despite the small parameter count. Next: I'll test a higher learning rate to see if we can optimize this larger model faster within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing learning rate to 0.1 to compensate for increased capacity and ensure better convergence with DEPTH=6.
